title: qgate JSON report, version 1
description: What `qgate check --format json` writes to standard output. Within version 1, keys and rule ids may be added; no key is removed, renamed or changes its type or meaning, and no severity is added. Unknown keys must be ignored.

schema_version.description: The format version. A reader that does not know it must not guess.

findings.description: What got worse, in the order the text format prints it: by path, then line (none first), then rule.

rule.description: The rule id, `<analyzer>/<rule>` in lowercase, e.g. `complexity/cyclomatic-increase`. New ids may appear within version 1.

message.description: One line for people. It may be reworded in any release; do not parse it.

path.description: The file, relative to the repository root (or as given, for two files).

end_line.description: The last line of a range that starts at `line`; it may equal `line`.

related.description: Other places the finding refers to, in an order the rule defines. For a duplicate block: the first copy in each file that holds the whole block, by path.

metric.description: The measured value before and after the change. `before` is absent for a new item, `after` for a removed one.

failing.description: How many findings are at or above the `fail_on` level; the run exits with 1 when this is not 0.
